integrity.computations: Standalone Python exhaustive checks for orders two and three only.
integrity.mathematical_basis: Explicit lower-central bracket computation, finite projective-plane incidence and generating-pair quotient.
integrity.originality_scope: Only counts of embedded nonabelian Heisenberg and filiform two-generated Lie subalgebras are asserted as new; pre-existing abelian-plane counts are excluded.

scientific_limitations: Two generators in the strictly upper-triangular four-by-four Lie algebra only; no subgroup or associative generation claim.
No claim of complete literature priority or independence; abelian two-plane count is prior work.
source_ids: Ceballos-Nunez-Tenorio, An. St. Univ. Ovidius Constanta 16(1) (2008) 59-66
Ceballos-Nunez-Tenorio, Triangular Configurations and Strictly Upper-Triangular Matrices Lie Algebras (2014)
title: Characteristic-sensitive enumeration of nonabelian two-generated subalgebras of the four-by-four niltriangular Lie algebra
